metadata.title: Data Security Policy - NailsZone
metadata.description: How NailsZone protects your personal information and complies with data protection regulations.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: At NailsZone, safeguarding the security and privacy of your personal information is our top priority. This Data Security Policy outlines the measures we implement to protect your data against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction. Our commitment to data security is in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)/California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA), and other relevant data protection regulations.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: This policy applies to all forms of data collected by NailsZone, including digital and physical formats, across all platforms where NailsZone operates.

data_collection_and_use.title: Data Collection and Use
data_collection_and_use.collection: Collection: We collect personal information necessary for providing and improving our services, as outlined in our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
data_collection_and_use.use: Use: Data is strictly used in accordance with the purposes for which it was collected, including service provision, communication, and improvement.

data_protection_measures.title: Data Protection Measures
data_protection_measures.encryption: Encryption: Personal data is encrypted during transmission and when stored on our servers.
data_protection_measures.access_control: Access Control: Access to personal data is limited to authorized personnel who are required to adhere to strict confidentiality obligations.
data_protection_measures.regular_audits: Regular Audits: We conduct regular audits and assessments to ensure compliance with our data security standards and to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.

data_breach_response.title: Data Breach Response
data_breach_response.notification: Notification: In the event of a data breach, we will notify affected individuals and relevant authorities as required by law, without undue delay.
data_breach_response.investigation: Investigation and Mitigation: We will promptly investigate any breach and take necessary steps to mitigate its impact and prevent future occurrences.

compliance_and_training.title: Compliance and Training
compliance_and_training.legal_compliance: Legal Compliance: We regularly review and update our data security practices to ensure compliance with current data protection laws.
compliance_and_training.employee_training: Employee Training: All employees receive training on data protection and security practices as part of their onboarding and on a regular basis thereafter.

third_party_service_providers.title: Third-Party Service Providers
third_party_service_providers.contracts: Contracts: We only engage with third-party service providers who commit to comply with our data security standards and data protection laws.
third_party_service_providers.monitoring: Monitoring: We monitor the compliance of third-party service providers with data protection obligations.

user_rights_and_data_management.title: User Rights and Data Management
user_rights_and_data_management.user_rights: User Rights: We respect your rights to access, correct, delete, and manage your personal data as detailed in our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
user_rights_and_data_management.data_retention: Data Retention: Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, in accordance with our data retention policy.

policy_updates.title: Policy Updates
policy_updates.description: This Data Security Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our practices or regulatory requirements. We will notify users of significant changes through our website or through direct communication.

contact_information.title: Contact Information
contact_information.description: For any questions or concerns about our Data Security Policy or the security of your personal information, please contact us at <email>teamnz@levincigroup.com</email>.
